name: Hazael
summary: A servant of Ben-hadad king of Syria who became king himself, as the LORD had shown Elijah and Elisha. As king he struck Israel again and again.

key_moments.title: Smothers His King and Takes the Throne
key_moments.description: Sent by his sick king to ask Elisha about healing, Hazael saw the prophet weep for the harm he would do to Israel. The next day Hazael spread a soaked cloth over the king's face until he died, and reigned in his place.

key_moments.title: Strikes Israel East of the Jordan
key_moments.description: The LORD started cutting away parts of Israel. Hazael struck them across the land east of the Jordan, including Gilead.

key_moments.title: Turned Back from Jerusalem
key_moments.description: Hazael captured Gath and set out for Jerusalem. Jehoash king of Judah sent him the holy things and the gold of the LORD's house, and Hazael went away.
